data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to create and display a rating stars bar with customizable size, colors, and axis.
data.what_it_does: Provides a RatingStars widget that renders customizable rating stars horizontally or vertically. It supports click interactions to change values, custom star builders, animations, and value label displays.
use_when: You need to display item ratings in your app.
You need an interactive star rating bar for user reviews or inputs.
avoid_when: You need complex form validation integration beyond standard widget callbacks.
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical orientations
Customizable star builders, colors, spacing, and rotation angles
Includes a built-in value label and click handling
weaknesses: No built-in form validation out of the box

alternatives.name: flutter_rating_bar
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative rating bar package with different customization options and feature sets.
